title: 荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘
subcategoryTitleEn: Tidal barriers, navigation and dam construction
summary: 本課以荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘為入口，深入浮運沉降、球鉸傳力與風暴期間可靠度的共同分析。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
summaryEn: Using Maeslant storm-surge barrier as its entry point, this course examines joint analysis of flotation, sinking, spherical-joint loading and storm reliability. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「浮運吃水與壓載」與「球鉸支臂力矩」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Floating draft and ballast" and "Spherical-joint arm moment": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 浮運吃水與壓載：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Floating draft and ballast: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「浮運吃水與壓載」如何影響荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Floating draft and ballast” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Maeslant storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 中空閘門靠排水體積承受自重，注水後有效浮力減少。水線面積決定增加重量所造成的吃水變化，不能用門高直接換算沉降。 假設水線面積1200 m²、加入淡水質量600 t，外水密度1025 kg/m³；ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m，限小吃水與固定水線面積。 艙內自由液面會削弱穩定性，即使總浮力平衡也可能出現傾斜。若一側進水較快，剛體平均吃水模型便漏掉扭轉與局部碰撞的危險。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「浮運吃水與壓載」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A hollow gate floats by displacement; ballast changes its net buoyancy. Waterplane area controls the draft change caused by added mass, rather than the overall gate height. Assume waterplane area 1200 m², added mass 600 t and external density 1025 kg/m³. ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m, for small changes and constant waterplane area. Internal free surfaces reduce stability even when total buoyancy balances weight. Unequal filling creates tilt, so a mean-draft model misses twisting and local collision hazards during the transition. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Floating draft and ballast” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水線面積1200 m²、加入淡水質量600 t，外水密度1025 kg/m³；ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m，限小吃水與固定水線面積。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume waterplane area 1200 m², added mass 600 t and external density 1025 kg/m³. ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m, for small changes and constant waterplane area.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「浮力與重量平衡就能保證門體漂浮姿態穩定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Balanced buoyancy and weight guarantee a stable floating attitude." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「浮運吃水與壓載」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Floating draft and ballast”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 浮運吃水與壓載
knowledge.text: 中空閘門靠排水體積承受自重，注水後有效浮力減少。水線面積決定增加重量所造成的吃水變化，不能用門高直接換算沉降。
knowledge.textEn: A hollow gate floats by displacement; ballast changes its net buoyancy. Waterplane area controls the draft change caused by added mass, rather than the overall gate height.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：浮力與重量平衡就能保證門體漂浮姿態穩定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Balanced buoyancy and weight guarantee a stable floating attitude. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「浮運吃水與壓載」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Floating draft and ballast" is correct?
options: 浮力與重量平衡就能保證門體漂浮姿態穩定。
中空閘門靠排水體積承受自重，注水後有效浮力減少。
球鉸能自由轉動，所以不會傳遞巨大的支承反力。
optionsEn: Balanced buoyancy and weight guarantee a stable floating attitude.
A hollow gate floats by displacement; ballast changes its net buoyancy.
A freely rotating spherical joint cannot transmit large support reactions.
quiz.explanation: 中空閘門靠排水體積承受自重，注水後有效浮力減少。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A hollow gate floats by displacement; ballast changes its net buoyancy. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 浮運吃水與壓載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Floating draft and ballast: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「浮運吃水與壓載」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Floating draft and ballast” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水線面積1200 m²、加入淡水質量600 t，外水密度1025 kg/m³；ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m，限小吃水與固定水線面積。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume waterplane area 1200 m², added mass 600 t and external density 1025 kg/m³. ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m, for small changes and constant waterplane area. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步比較左右吃水、艙內水量與門體傾角，檢查壓載質量是否與排水增量一致；把鹽度引起的外水密度變化另外列出。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare port and starboard drafts, ballast volume and tilt synchronously.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水線面積1200 m²、加入淡水質量600 t，外水密度1025 kg/m³；ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m，限小吃水與固定水線面積。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume waterplane area 1200 m², added mass 600 t and external density 1025 kg/m³. ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m, for small changes and constant waterplane area.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「浮運吃水與壓載」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Floating draft and ballast", which statement holds?
options: 曲面門體的靜水壓合力永遠只有水平方向分量。
總漏流減小就表示所有閘底局部流速都同時減小。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水線面積1200 m²、加入淡水質量600 t，外水密度1025 kg/m³。
optionsEn: Hydrostatic loading on a curved gate always has only a horizontal component.
Reduced total leakage means every local under-gate velocity also decreases.

Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume waterplane area 1200 m², added mass 600 t and external density 1025 kg/m³. ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m, for small changes and constant waterplane area.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水線面積1200 m²、加入淡水質量600 t，外水密度1025 kg/m³；ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m，限小吃水與固定水線面積。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume waterplane area 1200 m², added mass 600 t and external density 1025 kg/m³. ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m, for small changes and constant waterplane area. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 浮運吃水與壓載：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Floating draft and ballast: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「浮運吃水與壓載」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Floating draft and ballast” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步比較左右吃水、艙內水量與門體傾角，檢查壓載質量是否與排水增量一致；把鹽度引起的外水密度變化另外列出。利用各艙液位推算重心移動，核對觀測傾斜方向是否符合新增壓載的位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare port and starboard drafts, ballast volume and tilt synchronously. Check added mass against displaced volume and record salinity-related external density changes separately. Infer center-of-gravity movement from individual tank levels and check that observed heel matches the added ballast location. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以浮運吃水與壓載編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同步比較左右吃水、艙內水量與門體傾角，檢查壓載質量是否與排水增量一致；把鹽度引起的外水密度變化另外列出。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for floating draft and ballast, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare port and starboard drafts, ballast volume and tilt synchronously. Check added mass against displaced volume and record salinity-related external density changes separately.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：艙內自由液面會削弱穩定性，即使總浮力平衡也可能出現傾斜。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Internal free surfaces reduce stability even when total buoyancy balances weight. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步比較左右吃水、艙內水量與門體傾角，檢查壓載質量是否與排水增量一致；把鹽度引起的外水密度變化另外列出。利用各艙液位推算重心移動，核對觀測傾斜方向是否符合新增壓載的位置。
knowledge.textEn: Compare port and starboard drafts, ballast volume and tilt synchronously. Check added mass against displaced volume and record salinity-related external density changes separately. Infer center-of-gravity movement from individual tank levels and check that observed heel matches the added ballast location.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以浮運吃水與壓載編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同步比較左右吃水、艙內水量與門體傾角，檢查壓載質量是否與排水增量一致；把鹽度引起的外水密度變化另外列出。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for floating draft and ballast, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare port and starboard drafts, ballast volume and tilt synchronously. Check added mass against displaced volume and record salinity-related external density changes separately.

quiz.question: 要驗證「浮運吃水與壓載」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Floating draft and ballast"?
options: 同步比較左右吃水、艙內水量與門體傾角，檢查壓載質量是否與排水增量一致；把鹽度引起的外水密度變化另外列出。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
設備數量加倍就能直接把整體失效機率平方。
optionsEn: Compare port and starboard drafts, ballast volume and tilt synchronously.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Doubling equipment automatically squares the complete system failure probability.
quiz.explanation: 同步比較左右吃水、艙內水量與門體傾角，檢查壓載質量是否與排水增量一致；把鹽度引起的外水密度變化另外列出。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare port and starboard drafts, ballast volume and tilt synchronously. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 浮運吃水與壓載：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Floating draft and ballast: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「浮運吃水與壓載」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Floating draft and ballast” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 艙內自由液面會削弱穩定性，即使總浮力平衡也可能出現傾斜。若一側進水較快，剛體平均吃水模型便漏掉扭轉與局部碰撞的危險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Internal free surfaces reduce stability even when total buoyancy balances weight. Unequal filling creates tilt, so a mean-draft model misses twisting and local collision hazards during the transition. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若一側進水較快，剛體平均吃水模型便漏掉扭轉與局部碰撞的危險。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Unequal filling creates tilt, so a mean-draft model misses twisting and local collision hazards during the transition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「浮力與重量平衡就能保證門體漂浮姿態穩定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Balanced buoyancy and weight guarantee a stable floating attitude." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 艙內自由液面會削弱穩定性，即使總浮力平衡也可能出現傾斜。若一側進水較快，剛體平均吃水模型便漏掉扭轉與局部碰撞的危險。
knowledge.textEn: Internal free surfaces reduce stability even when total buoyancy balances weight. Unequal filling creates tilt, so a mean-draft model misses twisting and local collision hazards during the transition.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「浮運吃水與壓載」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Floating draft and ballast" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
艙內自由液面會削弱穩定性，即使總浮力平衡也可能出現傾斜。
球鉸能自由轉動，所以不會傳遞巨大的支承反力。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Internal free surfaces reduce stability even when total buoyancy balances weight.
A freely rotating spherical joint cannot transmit large support reactions.
quiz.explanation: 艙內自由液面會削弱穩定性，即使總浮力平衡也可能出現傾斜。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Internal free surfaces reduce stability even when total buoyancy balances weight. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 球鉸支臂力矩：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Spherical-joint arm moment: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「球鉸支臂力矩」如何影響荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Spherical-joint arm moment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Maeslant storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 球接頭容許多方向轉動，卻仍需把巨大門體荷載傳入陸側基礎。支臂幾何控制力矩和軸力分配，轉動自由不代表沒有反力。 假設水平合力8 MN、對基礎有效力臂60 m，外力矩M=Fr=480 MN·m；這是整體平衡量，非球鉸直接承受的純彎矩。 將球鉸錯當固定端會扭曲桁架內力，忽略支承摩擦又會低估局部拘束。若基礎轉動未列入，量測變形可能被錯誤解讀為鋼材損傷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「球鉸支臂力矩」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A spherical joint permits rotation in several directions while transmitting gate loads into shore foundations. Arm geometry controls moment and axial-force distribution; rotational freedom does not eliminate reaction forces. Assume horizontal resultant 8 MN and effective foundation lever arm 60 m. External moment M=Fr=480 MN·m is a global equilibrium quantity, not a pure moment carried directly by the ball joint. Treating the ball joint as fixed distorts truss forces, while omitting friction understates local restraint. Excluding foundation rotation can make measured movement appear to be steel damage. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Spherical-joint arm moment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume horizontal resultant 8 MN and effective foundation lever arm 60 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「球鉸能自由轉動，所以不會傳遞巨大的支承反力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A freely rotating spherical joint cannot transmit large support reactions." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Spherical-joint arm moment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: A spherical joint permits rotation in several directions while transmitting gate loads into shore foundations. Arm geometry controls moment and axial-force distribution; rotational freedom does not eliminate reaction forces.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：球鉸能自由轉動，所以不會傳遞巨大的支承反力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A freely rotating spherical joint cannot transmit large support reactions. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「球鉸支臂力矩」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Spherical-joint arm moment" is correct?
options: 球鉸能自由轉動，所以不會傳遞巨大的支承反力。
鋼材尚未降伏時，細長受壓桿件就不可能屈曲。
球接頭容許多方向轉動，卻仍需把巨大門體荷載傳入陸側基礎。
optionsEn: A freely rotating spherical joint cannot transmit large support reactions.
A slender compression member cannot buckle before its steel yields.
A spherical joint permits rotation in several directions while transmitting gate loads into shore foundations.
quiz.explanation: 球接頭容許多方向轉動，卻仍需把巨大門體荷載傳入陸側基礎。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A spherical joint permits rotation in several directions while transmitting gate loads into shore foundations. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 球鉸支臂力矩：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Spherical-joint arm moment: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「球鉸支臂力矩」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Spherical-joint arm moment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水平合力8 MN、對基礎有效力臂60 m，外力矩M=Fr=480 MN·m；這是整體平衡量，非球鉸直接承受的純彎矩。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume horizontal resultant 8 MN and effective foundation lever arm 60 m. External moment M=Fr=480 MN·m is a global equilibrium quantity, not a pure moment carried directly by the ball joint. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：繪出門體、支臂和球鉸分別的自由體圖，再用應變與位移方向核對內力路徑；確認力臂量的是垂直距離而非桁架長度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw separate free-body diagrams for gate, arm and joint.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水平合力8 MN、對基礎有效力臂60 m，外力矩M=Fr=480 MN·m；這是整體平衡量，非球鉸直接承受的純彎矩。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume horizontal resultant 8 MN and effective foundation lever arm 60 m. External moment M=Fr=480 MN·m is a global equilibrium quantity, not a pure moment carried directly by the ball joint.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「球鉸支臂力矩」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Spherical-joint arm moment", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水平合力8 MN、對基礎有效力臂60 m，外力矩M=Fr=480 MN·m；這是整體平衡量，非球鉸直接承受的純彎矩。
壓載艙半滿一定比空艙或全滿時更穩定。
漏流增加就足以證明止水橡膠老化，無須檢查水頭。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume horizontal resultant 8 MN and effective foundation lever arm 60 m.
A half-full ballast tank is always more stable than an empty or full tank.
Increasing leakage proves seal ageing without checking the head difference.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水平合力8 MN、對基礎有效力臂60 m，外力矩M=Fr=480 MN·m；這是整體平衡量，非球鉸直接承受的純彎矩。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume horizontal resultant 8 MN and effective foundation lever arm 60 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 球鉸支臂力矩：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Spherical-joint arm moment: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「球鉸支臂力矩」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Spherical-joint arm moment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 繪出門體、支臂和球鉸分別的自由體圖，再用應變與位移方向核對內力路徑；確認力臂量的是垂直距離而非桁架長度。將支臂內力重組為基礎合力，檢查向量和與外部門體水壓是否閉合。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw separate free-body diagrams for gate, arm and joint. Check load paths with strain and displacement directions, ensuring lever arm means perpendicular distance rather than truss length. Reassemble arm forces into foundation resultants and check vector closure against the externally applied gate pressure. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以球鉸支臂力矩編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。繪出門體、支臂和球鉸分別的自由體圖，再用應變與位移方向核對內力路徑；確認力臂量的是垂直距離而非桁架長度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for spherical-joint arm moment, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Draw separate free-body diagrams for gate, arm and joint. Check load paths with strain and displacement directions, ensuring lever arm means perpendicular distance rather than truss length.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將球鉸錯當固定端會扭曲桁架內力，忽略支承摩擦又會低估局部拘束。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating the ball joint as fixed distorts truss forces, while omitting friction understates local restraint. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 繪出門體、支臂和球鉸分別的自由體圖，再用應變與位移方向核對內力路徑；確認力臂量的是垂直距離而非桁架長度。將支臂內力重組為基礎合力，檢查向量和與外部門體水壓是否閉合。
knowledge.textEn: Draw separate free-body diagrams for gate, arm and joint. Check load paths with strain and displacement directions, ensuring lever arm means perpendicular distance rather than truss length. Reassemble arm forces into foundation resultants and check vector closure against the externally applied gate pressure.

knowledge.text: 以球鉸支臂力矩編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。繪出門體、支臂和球鉸分別的自由體圖，再用應變與位移方向核對內力路徑；確認力臂量的是垂直距離而非桁架長度。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for spherical-joint arm moment, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Draw separate free-body diagrams for gate, arm and joint. Check load paths with strain and displacement directions, ensuring lever arm means perpendicular distance rather than truss length.

quiz.question: 要驗證「球鉸支臂力矩」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。

多個測站讀數一致就能證明資料沒有過時問題。

Draw separate free-body diagrams for gate, arm and joint.
Agreement among several stations proves that none of their data is stale.

quiz.explanationEn: Draw separate free-body diagrams for gate, arm and joint. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 球鉸支臂力矩：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Spherical-joint arm moment: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「球鉸支臂力矩」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Spherical-joint arm moment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將球鉸錯當固定端會扭曲桁架內力，忽略支承摩擦又會低估局部拘束。若基礎轉動未列入，量測變形可能被錯誤解讀為鋼材損傷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating the ball joint as fixed distorts truss forces, while omitting friction understates local restraint. Excluding foundation rotation can make measured movement appear to be steel damage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若基礎轉動未列入，量測變形可能被錯誤解讀為鋼材損傷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Excluding foundation rotation can make measured movement appear to be steel damage.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「球鉸能自由轉動，所以不會傳遞巨大的支承反力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A freely rotating spherical joint cannot transmit large support reactions." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將球鉸錯當固定端會扭曲桁架內力，忽略支承摩擦又會低估局部拘束。若基礎轉動未列入，量測變形可能被錯誤解讀為鋼材損傷。
knowledge.textEn: Treating the ball joint as fixed distorts truss forces, while omitting friction understates local restraint. Excluding foundation rotation can make measured movement appear to be steel damage.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「球鉸支臂力矩」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Spherical-joint arm moment" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
鋼材尚未降伏時，細長受壓桿件就不可能屈曲。
將球鉸錯當固定端會扭曲桁架內力，忽略支承摩擦又會低估局部拘束。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A slender compression member cannot buckle before its steel yields.
Treating the ball joint as fixed distorts truss forces, while omitting friction understates local restraint.
quiz.explanation: 將球鉸錯當固定端會扭曲桁架內力，忽略支承摩擦又會低估局部拘束。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating the ball joint as fixed distorts truss forces, while omitting friction understates local restraint. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
